_about: Agentforce mock conversations (PLAN.md §5.8). One agent per audience group (D12). Each agent has a greeting, intents and a fallback. A message matches the intent with the most `match` hits (regular expressions, case-insensitive); a mention of a program or certificate counts for intents with `mentions`. Each greeting and intent lists `responses`, and the first one whose `when` matches the visitor is used, so known-profile answers come first and the last response (no `when`) works for anyone. `when` uses the personalization conditions (person, stage, topAffinity + minScore, affinity + minScore, conversion) plus `has`, which is true when a [[token]] has a value. Every response has quick-reply `chips`; `links` are buttons; `identify: true` shows the chat sign-in form; `card` shows an estimate. [[tokens]] are filled from the visitor's profile in the browser; {{facts.path}} tokens from content/facts.json. Unmatched questions are answered from the site's own pages before the fallback. The build fails on an unknown condition, token, fact or link.
